result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but it shows one clearly broken data value and some content is obscured or clipped at the viewport edges.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card displays “€NaN delivery,” exposing an invalid or missing delivery-price value.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery-fee calculation/data binding and show a valid amount or a fallback such as “Delivery fee unavailable.”

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the second restaurant card, cutting off its image and hiding the rest of the card content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page or ensure the fixed navigation reserves space so cards can be fully viewed.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel is visibly cut off on the right, leaving the third card and its title partially outside the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure this is an intentional horizontal carousel with clear scroll affordance, or adjust card sizing/margins so the layout does not appear accidentally clipped.

issues.description: The category-chip row also extends beyond the right edge, with a partially visible final chip and no obvious indication that the row is horizontally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll cue or gradient fade, or fit the chips responsively within the available width.
